tool_args.rationale: The paid observations support the supplied uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt creep law. Fit its two positive parameters numerically from all rows; confirmation will evaluate the forecast without purchasing another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight paid rows vary x_now and H while y/u_now stays tightly clustered; the existing data are sufficient to fit and freshly confirm the two-parameter Kelvin–Voigt form.
Its predicted output depends on x_now, but observed responses remain close to proportional to u_now across substantial x_now changes.
The observed near-linear scaling with u_now does not match the supplied present-snapshot VFT form.
